essence.heading: KaiSol Romance Resort
essence.p1: KaiSol Romance Resort is part of the KaiSol luxury hotel chain that promises the ultimate rejuvenation experience. With an ideal location in the tranquil air and blue seas of Sahl Hasheesh, KaiSol Romance Resort is the perfect escape from reality.
essence.p2: KaiSol Romance Resort is an adults-only hotel adorned with various facilities, activities, and all-day, all-night entertainment. KaiSol promises a tailored vacation for honeymooners, couples, and young groups to indulge in the heavenly mix of luxury accommodation and tropical retreat.
essence.spec1desc: For honeymooners, couples and young groups — a heavenly mix of luxury accommodation and tropical retreat.
essence.spec2desc: An ideal location in tranquil air and blue seas — the perfect escape from reality.

reviews.q1: From sunrise on our private beachfront deck to dinner on the lantern-lit pier, KaiSol is pure enchantment. The quiet sophistication and heartfelt discretion redefined luxury travel for us.
reviews.q2: A masterclass in modern adult sanctuaries. Zero intrusive clamor, breathtaking architecture that breathes with the sea breeze, and culinary standards that rival Florence.
reviews.a3: Condé Nast Traveler · Gold List Recommended

responsibility.heading: A Greener Future
responsibility.sub: A getaway for our guests and a friend to nature — fresh air, lush landscapes and responsible hospitality.

items.title: Greener Future
items.desc: Lush landscapes and greenery surround the resort — fresh air for better sleep, health and quality of life.

items.title: Conserving Resources
items.desc: Sheets and towels change only on request, and every room carries our water-saving promise.

items.title: Love Food, Hate Waste
items.desc: Daily food-waste awareness at our open buffet encourages portions that are just right.

items.title: Waste Reduction
items.desc: Less plastic every day — acrylic cups, sustainable straws and careful recycling.

items.title: Supporting Local Communities
items.desc: Cups, centerpieces and decor made locally by the people of Egypt.

sustainability.heading: Travelife Gold Certified
sustainability.sub: Our public sustainability report tracks short- and long-term goals across the hotel — strengthening the economic, social and environmental life of the resort while preserving regional heritage.
